description: Multi-playhead arbitrary function generator family inspired by the Buchla 248 MARF

modules.name: PROGRAM
modules.description: Programming section anchor: stage select, voltage/time/mode modifiers, presets, external inputs, poly out

modules.name: STAGE4
modules.description: 4-stage slider block, chainable right of PROGRAM

modules.name: HEAD
modules.description: Function Generator playhead, chainable left of PROGRAM

modules.name: MIDI
modules.description: MIDI gateway for clock, transport, preset, CC control and outgoing instrument messages

modules.name: GLUE LEFT
modules.description: SpaceTime virtual expander bridge for the right-hand chain fragment

modules.name: GLUE RIGHT
modules.description: SpaceTime virtual expander bridge for the left-hand chain fragment

modules.name: WidgetTest
modules.description: Development widget exerciser — not for patches
